SELECT s.region, s.format, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) n_stores, min(s.valid_from), max(s.valid_to), count(*) versions
FROM dim_store s
WHERE s.valid_from <= DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.valid_to >= DATE '2024-08-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT f.vat_rate, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS from_sep, p.vat_class, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatches,
 count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'dup receipt+line' chk, count(*) n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-10' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'store key outside validity', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND (f.sale_date < s.valid_from OR f.sale_date > s.valid_to)
UNION ALL SELECT 'store 999 lines', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ Test lines', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND p.category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines (store 900)', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines no order row', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'channel_code WB not store 900', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND ((f.channel_code='WB') <> (s.store_id=900))
UNION ALL SELECT 'null gross/net', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND (gross_amount IS NULL OR net_amount IS NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff lines', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines sale_date vs ts helsinki mismatch', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> f.sale_date

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
         s.region, s.store_id, f.gross_amount, f.sale_date, o.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-06-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30'
)
SELECT region,
  sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) aug_dispatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) sep_dispatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) aug_saledate,
  sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) sep_saledate,
  count(CASE WHEN business_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) null_bd,
  count(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 END) odd_status
FROM lines GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS bd, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'),
a AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_amount) mine FROM l WHERE bd BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(a.store_id,b.store_id) store_id, a.mine, b.rpt, round(a.mine-b.rpt,2) diff
FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.store_id=b.store_id
WHERE a.mine IS NULL OR b.rpt IS NULL OR abs(a.mine-b.rpt)>0.01
UNION ALL SELECT -1, sum(a.mine), sum(b.rpt), round(sum(a.mine)-sum(b.rpt),2) FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.store_id=b.store_id
ORDER BY 1
